{{Dialogue|Vaantar|He is constructed similarly to you, but with his covering surface smooth and soft and shimmering like a rainbow.|Grave|His covering? You mean his skin?|Vaantar|His skin, yes. His head covering is arranged similarly to yours, but the tendrils are much longer and pure black. His eyes are&hellip; I don't know the word. They are bright yellow, and give off many small reflections.|Brightwater|Multifaceted, like an insect's?|attr=[[Vaantaar]] describing Nuso Esva's people to [[Taxtro Grave]] and [[Korlo Brightwater]]|src=<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
The [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] warlike [[Species/Legends|species]] known to the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Quesoth]] as the '''Storm-hairs''' emerged from an Unknown Regions [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva)|planet]], led by the brutal Storm-hair [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], and ravaged Unknown Regions and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Nuso Esva's realm]] had expanded its reign&mdash;considered a reign of terror&mdash;to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] fringes.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
